title: What does this print? (count heads)
statement:
What does this program print?

```python
import numpy as np

flips = np.array([[$f.arr]])
print(np.count_nonzero(flips == 'H') / len(flips))
```

[______]{a}

feedback.message: `count_nonzero` gives the count; the program then divides by the number of flips.

hints: `flips == 'H'` is an array of True/False, one per flip.
`np.count_nonzero` counts the Trues: the number of heads.
solution: There are [$f.h] heads among [$f.n] flips, so it prints [$f.h]/[$f.n] = [$f.p].
